OnHand AI is not an official Ollama app. The app uses MIT-0; Ollama, llama.cpp and model weights have their own licenses. Check commercial-use terms.

1. Open Models and pick a recommended model.
2. Download it over Wi-Fi. Model files can be hundreds of MB or several GB.
3. Chat offline after installation.
